question: Which strategy is NOT mentioned as part of public-education initiatives?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses public-education initiatives aimed at addressing vaccine hesitancy and promoting herd immunity.
 
• It mentions **radio broadcasts**, **social media**, and **school programs** as strategies used for public education.
 
• There is no mention of providing **financial incentives** as part of these public-education initiatives.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Radio broadcasts** – Mentioned as a medium to disseminate information about vaccination campaigns. (रेडियो प्रसारण)
 
• **Option 2: Social-media influencers** – The passage refers broadly to social media platforms to spread awareness. (सोशल मीडिया)
 
• **Option 3: School programs** – Educational initiatives through schools are cited as a way to reach children and families. (स्कूल कार्यक्रम)
